business_scope.primary_industry_name: Visual Web Template and Low-Code Web Application Builder

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (Unitary national jurisdiction; company registry operated at the local Cámara de Comercio level)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Unitary National; codified commercial law under Código de Comercio, Decree 410 of 1971, and special SAS statute Ley 1258 of 2008)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Alianza del Pacífico framework agreement (Mexico, Chile, Peru; additional protocol 2016)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (UIAF creation); Ley 1121 de 2006 (AML amendments); Ley 1258 de 2008 (SAS statute); Código de Comercio Decree 410/1971 as compiled in Decree 1074 de 2015; Superintendencia de Sociedades Circular Básica Jurídica (SAGRILAFT chapter, as amended); Decreto 830 de 2021 (UIAF and PEP regime); Resolución DIAN No. 000164 de 2021 establishing the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (RBF). A newly incorporated SAS must file its RBF declaration with DIAN within two (2) months after registration and update it annually during the official filing window.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney (poder especial) authorizing the SAS incorporator or attorney-in-fact to execute the private incorporation document on behalf of each non-resident shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the shareholder's country of domicile or a Colombian Consulate abroad
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for shareholders resident in Apostille Convention states; Consular Legalization for non-Hague jurisdictions; certified Spanish translation by a traductor oficial required at filing

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of valid passport for each foreign individual shareholder, evidencing identity and tax residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority or notary public in the country of issuance
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization; certified Spanish translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation of any foreign corporate shareholder and its board resolution approving the Colombian incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction; for Colombian corporate shareholders, the relevant Cámara de Comercio
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for foreign corporate shareholders OR Consular Legalization; domestic Colombian certificates require no apostille and are filed as notarized copies

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Evidence of the virtual-office provider's legal existence (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal) to support the registered-domicile pillar
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Cámara de Comercio of the virtual-office provider's domicile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic authentication; certified Chamber copy, no apostille required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of UBOs, shareholders, legal representatives, and appointed agents against (i) Colombian national watchlists maintained by UIAF and law-enforcement authorities, (ii) OFAC SDN list, (iii) UN Security Council consolidated list, (iv) Interpol red notices, and (v) domestic Colombian PEP registries. PEP status triggers enhanced due diligence under Ley 1474 de 2011 and the SAGRILAFT chapter of the Circular Básica Jurídica. Adverse-media monitoring must be documented pre-incorporation and refreshed upon any UBO change or at least annually; all screening outputs must be retained in the compliance file.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) with the local Cámara de Comercio of the chosen domicile (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá - www.ccb.org.co); homonym check performed online via the name validation module
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed name must be distinctive, with no identical or confusingly similar prior registration, and written in Latin script; Spanish is the operating language, so any foreign-language token must be accompanied by a Spanish descriptor of the corporate purpose; the corporate name must include the S.A.S. suffix; names in non-Latin scripts are not admissible and no official transliteration certificate is required for Latin-script names.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Colombia (restricted token requiring evidenced governmental permission)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A rejected or flagged name may be replaced by submitting a new RUES name request with a different distinctive token, normally resolved within one (1) to three (3) business days. If the applicant disputes an administrative rejection, file a reconsideration appeal (recurso de reposición) before the same Cámara de Comercio within ten (10) business days of notice; if denied, file the subsidiary appeal (recurso de apelación) addressed to the Superintendencia de Sociedades under Law 1437 of 2011 (CPACA). The Chamber must issue a written decision. During any pending appeal the name is not reserved, so a parallel new-name filing is recommended to avoid project delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for a fully digital SaaS exporter provided the virtual-office provider is an established commercial co-working or registered-address firm able to accept service of process, Chamber notifications, and DIAN correspondence at the registered address. Each Cámara de Comercio may require the physical address to be verifiable and not a PO Box. The private incorporation document must state the domicile city and full address. Local bank onboarding may request a service contract and monthly invoices from the provider, so a contractual relationship with a reputable provider is strongly recommended. Overall acceptance threshold is high for low-risk, export-only ISIC 6201 activities.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate: approximately 10-15% probability of an unannounced verification visit within the first 24 months of operation. The likelihood rises if multiple entities are registered at one co-working address, if DIAN filings show zero local operational expenses, or if a VAT or withholding tax desk audit is triggered. Risk is mitigated by consistent export invoicing, an updated RUT containing the correct domicile and economic activities, and a contractual mail-forwarding and notice-handling protocol with the virtual-office provider.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry tariff (approximately COP 34,000; varies slightly by Chamber)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation corporate due diligence and drafting of the private incorporation document and SAS bylaws
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; fixed fee for a single or multi non-resident shareholder structure

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO piercing, PEP/OFAC/UN sanctions screening, and tax-residence analysis for each shareholder and legal representative
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per UBO and board member; credited against the annual SAGRILAFT retainer if adopted

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and apostille bundle (power of attorney, passport copies, certificates of good standing)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public in the shareholder jurisdiction plus the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the issuing state or the Colombian Consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Uniform notary tariff plus Hague apostille fee plus courier; approximately USD 25-35 per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Cámara de Comercio registration fee and legalization of the incorporation documents (derechos de inscripción)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff scaled by nominal capital; lowest band for capital under COP 10,000,000

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RUT and NIT tax identification pre-registration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory fee; mandatory online procedure resulting in assignment of the NIT

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Virtual office and registered commercial address, 12-month subscription
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark in Bogotá; approximately COP 700,000 per year including mail handling

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and compliance continuity retainer for the first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; covers receipt of public-authority notices, registry follow-ups, and compliance mailbox

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Contingency reserve for certified Spanish translation, courier, certified copies, and bank-format certificates
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified translator, notary, or courier service
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; approximately 5-6% contingency over legal and registry fees

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971) Arts. 98-136, and Decree 1074/2015 Arts. 1.1.1.1-1.2.2.11
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (Registro Mercantil) and Superintendencia de Sociedades (vigilance only for large SAS; optional for small forms)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (executed before notary when not all paid-in assets are cash) and Registro del Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for S.A.S.; capital may be subscribed partially, but at least one share must be issued and payment terms set. No escrow account is required unless a specific business requires a special regime (not applicable here).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The incorporation of the Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada is ratified and the capital subscription, as set out in the Certificate of Incorporation, is approved and each subscriber accepts the number and class of shares allotted. (2) The Bylaws, as executed, are adopted and declared binding upon all shareholders. (3) The registered office is established at the address stated in the Certificate, within the jurisdiction of the Cámara de Comercio of Bogotá. (4) The Sole Legal Representative and the Principal Accountant are appointed, and each hereby accepts office. (5) The Legal Representative is authorized to complete the registration of the company with the Cámara de Comercio, obtain the NIT-RUT, open bank accounts, and execute all ancillary documents required to commence lawful operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Pre-Approval and Homonymy Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá – Online portal 'Registro en Línea' (www.ccb.org.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The incorporator must log in to the Chamber of Commerce registry portal, request a 'Certificado de Homonimia' by filing up to three proposed corporate names, and submit a QR-validated PDF of the applicant's national ID (cédula) or passport. The system verifies trademark and registry conflicts in the Mercantile Registry and issues the name reservation certificate valid for 30 calendar days.
required_dossiers: Identity document (cédula or valid passport) of the subscribing shareholder
Proof of legal residence or foreign investor registration (if non-resident)
Proposed company name (up to three alternatives)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name conflicts with an existing trademark, a substitute reservation must be filed within 5 business days; the previous reservation certificate is automatically cancelled and no fee refund applies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of the Private Incorporation Document (Bylaws)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Notaría) for signature authentication; the incorporator drafts the document with legal counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The bylaws must provide: corporate name, purpose (SAS engaged in software development and no-code web application building), authorized capital, share classes, shareholder voting rules, administration structure (sole legal representative or board), internal controls, and dissolution rules. If any shareholder contributes assets other than cash, the document must be elevated to public deed before a Colombian notary. Each shareholder signs the document, and the legal representative's acceptance of office is evidenced by signature.
required_dossiers: Identity documents of all shareholders
Name reservation certificate (Certificado de Homonimia)
Draft Bylaws (Estatutos)
Declaration of share subscription and payment conditions
Certificate of no tax debt for each subscribing shareholder (for notarization, if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary notes a formal defect, the document must be refiled within 15 calendar days with corrections; no additional state fee is charged for one correction round.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Mercantile Registry (Cámara de Comercio)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá – Registro Mercantil branch (in-person or online)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the signed bylaws, the name reservation certificate, the pre-RUT (certificado de preinscripción) from DIAN, and the registration form (Formulario de Matrícula). Upon validation, the Chamber issues the 'Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal' and assigns the permanent NIT. The incorporation fee is calculated based on the declared capital amount and published tariff table.
required_dossiers: Signed private incorporation document (or public deed)
Name reservation certificate
Pre-RUT certificate issued by DIAN
Shareholders' identity documents
Payment receipt for registration fee (approx. USD 35 based on declared capital)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registration is queried (e.g., missing or contradictory field), the incorporator must file a rectification petition (solicitud de subsanación) through the portal within 20 business days; a response is issued within 5 business days, and judicial appeal to the Superintendencia de Sociedades is available if the Chamber persists.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) – online portal (www.dian.gov.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once the NIT is assigned, the incorporator must finalize the RUT registration by electronically filing the 'Registro Único Tributario' form via the DIAN virtual office (Muisca system). The legal representative must activate an electronic signature (firma electrónica) and obtain password authorization to issue electronic invoices (facturación electrónica). The tax class (régimen común) and income tax liability class must be confirmed.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation issued by the Chamber of Commerce
Legal representative's ID and email address
Shareholders' RUTs (if exists)
Certificate of bank account opening (for some cases)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects the RUT file due to incomplete data, resubmit within 10 business days with mandatory information. DIAN automatically grants a provisional RUT, but the final RUT can require a physical verification visit by tax officials for high-risk sectors; for IT services this is rare.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Registration for Industry and Commerce Tax (ICA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Secretaría de Hacienda of Bogotá D.C. (Sistema Distrital de Rentas)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days of incorporation, the company must register for base municipal taxes: Industria y Comercio (ICA) and Avisos y Tableros. File form 'Declaración de Inscripción' electronically through the Bogotá tax portal (www.haciendabogota.gov.co) using the RUT. The SLA tax is filed on the ICA; however, since the company provides remote software services to export clients, a zero-rate ICA benefit may apply under the 'Exención de Servicios de Tecnología' rules, requiring only a sworn affidavit of export compliance.
required_dossiers: RUT (final)
Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
Lease contract or proof of registered office address
Sworn statement of business activity and expected revenues
ICA registration form (Formulario ICA–051)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality improperly assesses the ICA, file an 'Recurso de Reconsideración' within 30 business days; maintain proof of export invoicing to substantiate the tax exemption.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Operational Setup (Banking, Accounting, and Social Security)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Private banks (e.g., Bancolombia, Banco de Bogotá) and Ministry of Health/ARL (Administradoras de Riesgos Laborales)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate checking account using the NIT and the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation. Contract a certified public accountant (Revisor Fiscal is not mandatory for small SAS unless assets exceed COP 5,000 million). Affiliate the legal representative and employees with the EPS (health), AFP (pension), and ARL (occupational risk insurer) within 48 hours before any paid work starts. Obtain electronic invoicing resolution from DIAN and configure Stripe/Paddle payment rails with Colombian invoicing requirements (Radian electronic document).
required_dossiers: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation (updated)
RUT
Shareholders meeting minutes appointing the legal representative
Proof of registered office address
Bank account opening form for the legal representative
Employment or service contracts for the workforce
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses the account (unusual for low-risk software business), file a formal complaint to the customer ombudsman or choose an alternative bank; the process repeats with the same dossier. Missing ARL registration can be cured within 3 days by submitting a retroactive affiliation; fines are waived if corrected voluntarily.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Tecnologías de la Información y las Comunicaciones (MinTIC) – Registro de Operadores de Servicios de Tecnología (notified, not licensed)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No operating license required for software design, development, and no-code web application services under Decree 1078/2015; only an optional Voluntary Technology Services Registry (RSTA) is available

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente de Bogotá / ANLA (Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales) if waste disposal thresholds exceed 10 tons/year
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – EIA is not required for software development (ISIC 6201); no physical discharges or significant emissions. Only a general duty to manage electronic waste (EEE waste) in accordance with Resolution 1512/2010 for small quantities of ICT equipment is imposed.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or VOC emissions are generated in coding operations. If the office has servers or generates e-waste, comply with Resolution 1512/2010 (proper segregated collection and disposal of computer scrap) and general potable water connection for the office space.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate (Concepto Técnico de Bomberos) required for commercial office units with occupancy capacity exceeding 50 persons or load factor > 4 people per 10 m²; the company must maintain a basic workplace safety program (SG-SST) under Law 1562/2012, including training records for the legal representative and team. No structural load inspection is required for a software office housed in a commercially approved building, but the lease contract must include a certificate of habitability (certificado de habitabilidad).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — national tax and customs authority; official portal: www.dian.gov.co; e-filing and administrative services via MUISCA web platform; customs clearance via SIGLO XXI and VUCE.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: (1) Incorporate the S.A.S. through private document before the Cámara de Comercio (no minimum capital); the RUES mercantile registration automatically assigns the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). (2) Complete and certify the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) via MUISCA/PRO-RUT, declaring ISIC 6201 activity, legal representative, and the IMC foreign-exchange bank account. (3) Foreign shareholders: provide apostilled certificate of incorporation and passport copies; a Colombian tax-resident legal representative is mandatory. (4) Activate the electronic signature (firma electrónica) and register the e-invoicing system within the RUT. (5) If the foreign shareholder operates a Colombian permanent establishment, register the branch NIT; otherwise no additional NIT is required. Total timeline: 3–10 business days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the S.A.S. is a Colombian tax-resident company subject to national corporate income tax at 35% (2024 rate) on worldwide income, including software export revenue; qualifying software-export income may additionally access a limited 5-year 'economía naranja' income-tax renta exenta; no pass-through treatment applies to shareholders.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists. Available elections: (a) voluntary inclusion in the Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE), a combined income/VAT presumptive regime for gross income up to 100,000 UVT (approx. COP 4,706 million in 2024), generally suboptimal for export-focused SaaS; (b) mandatory VAT 0% on export services (Art. 481 E.T.), formalized through FEV export invoicing; (c) election to offset VAT refundable balances against income-tax liabilities; (d) election of the 5-year economía naranja exemption for qualifying software activities (ISIC 6201 with at least 80% software-derived revenue); (e) Law 2277/2022 anti-hybrid rules, which restrict deductibility of hybrid payments and require no election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax — Impuesto sobre las Ventas (IVA); single national indirect tax with no sub-central sales tax; excise duties apply only to selected goods.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: 3,500 UVT for ordinary small merchants (COP 164,727,500 for FY2024, UVT = COP 47,065). Non-importing and non-exporting merchants below this threshold may register as 'no responsables' and remain outside the IVA system; however, an exporter of services, including low-code/SaaS providers, is compulsorily required to register as an IVA-responsible taxpayer irrespective of turnover because export zero-rating and refund rights are available only to registered exporters.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time Factura Electrónica de Venta (FEV) under DIAN Res. 000165/2023 for all IVA-responsible taxpayers including software exporters. Each FEV must be transmitted to DIAN via API (WSDL/SOAP web service) or the free DIAN web portal, and must embed a CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica), a QR verification code, and the export-of-services annotation. Purchases from unregistered sellers require the Documento Soporte en Adquisiciones with CUDS filing. The system mandates immediate validation, defined contingency procedures during DIAN outages, and continuous compliance updates issued by DIAN resolution.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: VAT 0% with refund rights (excluido con derecho a devolución) applies to exported services under Art. 481(4) E.T. and Decree 1625/2016 (Arts. 1.6.1.12.5–1.6.1.12.20). The visual low-code/website-builder service (ISIC 6201) qualifies when: (i) the recipient is a non-resident without Colombian domicile; (ii) the service is exploited exclusively outside Colombia (offshore benefit test); (iii) the foreign payer remits the consideration in foreign currency through a Colombian authorised FX intermediary; and (iv) the exporter issues the FEV with the export coding, retains the contract, and files the exchange declaration and Información Exógena. Failure of any condition recharacterizes the sale as a 19% taxable domestic service with full clawback exposure.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: FEV (Factura Electrónica de Venta) with zero-rated export code, CUFE and QR validation
Written service agreement with the foreign client containing exclusive-overseas-use clause and offshore consideration
Certificado de Reintegro de Divisas (FX repatriation certificate issued by the Colombian IMC)
Declaración de Cambio Formulario No. 5 (exchange declaration for services) stamped by the intermediary
RUT excerpt evidencing ISIC 6201 activity and IVA-responsible status
For physical/digital goods accompanying the service: DEX (Declaración de Exportación), Bill of Lading/Air Waybill, and commercial export invoice
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may audit within the 5-year limitation period (Art. 705 E.T.). Rejected zero-rating triggers VAT reinstatement at 19% plus moratory interest, an inexactitud fine of up to 160% of the understated tax, and fines up to 100% on amounts intended to inflate refunds. Late or absent FX repatriation retroactively revokes the export treatment with the same clawback and interest. Criminal tax evasion (Art. 434B C.P.) carries 4–9 years imprisonment when the evasion exceeds 250 SMMLV (approx. COP 325 million in 2024); fraudulent export claims may additionally be prosecuted as aggravated contrabando (Law 1762/2015). Ancillary sanctions include suspension of the RUT and e-invoicing authorization, and exógena information fines up to COP 18,000 per incorrect or omitted record.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (annual commercial registry renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over the registered office (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March; renewal window runs from 2 January to 31 March; no statutory extension
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers surcharge equal to the annual renewal tariff for each overdue year and loss of evidentiary weight of statutory books; more than one year in arrears leads to registration suspension and administrative strike-off requiring full re-registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Acta de la Asamblea Anual de Accionistas (annual shareholders' meeting minutes)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (mercantile registry registration of the corporate minutes)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Meeting to approve prior-year financial statements held no later than 31 March; minutes filed with the Chamber within 30 days after the meeting (by 30 April for calendar-year companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unregistered minutes are unenforceable against third parties; the registry renewal is rejected until the minutes are recorded; Chamber sanctions may be imposed for persistent non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Estados Financieros de Cierre (annual financial statements under IFRS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (deposited through the SIR business information system together with the renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March for approval at the shareholders' meeting; registered with the Chamber within 30 days after approval (by 30 April)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: The renewal is deemed incomplete until financial statements are deposited; Superintendencia de Sociedades may impose fines up to 100 SMMLV (approximately USD 23,000) for failure to file statements with the Chamber.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (annual corporate income-tax return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in August of the year following the taxable period; exact date assigned by DIAN according to the final NIT digit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 5% of the tax assessed per month or fraction of month, capped at 100% of the tax; if no tax is due, 1% of gross income subject to the statutory cap under Article 641 ET; late payment additionally accrues mora interest.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Información Exógena anual (yearly information return to DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in April; DIAN assigns filing dates by the final digit of the NIT
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or material errors subject to a fine of 4% of the amounts not reported (minimum 0.5% of net revenues); where amounts cannot be quantified, fixed penalty per Article 651 ET (approximately COP 15 million / USD 3,600); repeat non-compliance doubles the sanction.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Confirmación Anual de Beneficiarios Finales (UBO report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 June for unchanged beneficial-owner data; updated data due by 31 July; both windows are fixed by Resolution 164 of 2021
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to report, incomplete data, or outdated data triggers a correction notice and, if unresolved, fines up to 200 SMMLV (approximately USD 62,000) jointly against the company and the legal representative.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración anual de Industria y Comercio (ICA) for software and IT services
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Municipal or district tax authority (e.g., Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda in Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in January to February for the preceding calendar year of gross service revenue; larger taxpayers must make bimonthly prepayments
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing and payment subject to municipal penalties of approximately 3% per month of the tax due (capped at 100%) plus mora interest and risk of municipal audit; exported software services may qualify for the ICA export exclusion when statutory requirements are met.

stage_6.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 110 – Declaración Anual de Renta y Complementario para Sociedades y Entidades Nacionales; e-file via DIAN MUISCA portal (www.dian.gov.co → MUISCA) using authorized electronic signature/certificate
stage_6.reporting_frequency: Annual (one filing per calendar fiscal year; no quarterly CIT prepayments — ICA and withholding are separate monthly obligations)
stage_6.statutory_deadline_rule: Due dates set annually by DIAN resolution by reference to the last two digits of the NIT; for calendar-year entities, the filing window for the preceding year generally runs from the last week of February through mid-April (e.g., FY2024 returns: 27 February 2025 – 17 April 2025). Companies with a non-December fiscal year-end must file within the same calendar months following year-end under the DIAN schedule.
